notes.title: Game Update 1.5.4: Dance of the Throne Release!
notes.content:
General


 New add-on content Dance of the Throne.
 Elena, the leader of Demiurge, will be arriving as a playable character. You'll use Elena to challenge rearranged stages and enemy configurations in Pascal's Wager. Defeat all enemies as quickly as possible, rack up chains, obtain your highest score, and fight your way to the top of the leaderboard against players from all over the world.

Bugfixes


 Fixed an issue where Proxy Higgins’s major attack might fail to perform.
 Fixed an issue where the teleportation move of Fused Sprenger might be interrupted.
 General stability and bugfixes.
 Fixed an issue that may cause effect stacking issues for Jerold.
 Fixed a few VFX display issues.
 Fixed an issue where certain minions summoned by bosses might move outside of the encounter space.
 Fixed several collision issues that may cause players to be stuck.

notes.title: Game Update 1.2.3: Bugfixes, DualSense Support
notes.content:
This update addresses some gameplay bugs and added support for DualSense controllers.

General

 The game now correctly recognizes DualSense controller as input device.

 Damage number display changes.

 Balance tuning for bleeding effects.

notes.title: Game Update 1.2.1: Terrence Parry bugfix
notes.content:
This small update fixes the parry/counterattack issue introduced with Update 1.2.0.

Localization

 Benita's Elixir - Wind Breath now correctly states its effect of enhanced stamina regeneration instead of health in European/LATAM languages.
Bugfixes

 Fixed an issue causing Terrence's counterattack to deal no damage when using the alternate outfit.

notes.title: Game Update 1.2.0: Fov Slider, Exclusive Fullscreen and Visual Effect Toggle
notes.content:
We just released the first major update to Pascal's Wager: Definitive Edition, which includes a lot of the changes we outlined in our March Development Update. After the update the game should show 1.0.2(1000) in the bottom left corner of the main menu.

Full patch notes below:

General

 Added exclusive fullscreen display mode. The original Fullscreen mode is renamed to Borderless. Windowed mode is unchanged.
 Added a field of view (FoV) slider.
 Added a toggle for abnormal effects, which controls the intensity of chromatic abberation and vignette effect when characters are under abnormal status.
 On screen input prompts now correctly changes based on the control method used.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39916525/66e6c7bc683a44c2b75b065fa8b01dac362946b9.jpg

Localization

 Standardized Health Potion capacity upgrade talent in European/LATAM languages.
 Fixed an issue where the passive text on Chaos Silk is missing in European/LATAM languages.
 Fixed Benita's talent "Elixir Research" to correctly state its blessing related effect in European/LATAM languages.
Combat

 Widened parry/counterattack window for Terrence.
 Increased movement speed of Terrence and Norwood when locking onto enemies.
 Increased the effectiveness of Terrence's "Knight's Tenacity" talent (heavy attacks are harder to interrupt).
Bugfixes

 Fixed an issue causing Viola's followed up attack after a Light Combo to miss enemies occasionally.
 Fixed several special effect issues.

What's Left Out There?

Out of the items we wish to address in our Development Update, there are a few things left we are releasing soon after and at later dates.

Steam Trading Card: we are finalizing the review process with Valve and will enable this feature once everything goes through.

UI Improvements: the changes to overall UI elements will take more time than we expected, and we want to make sure the final results meets your expectations and our own standard, so it will be included in an upcoming update.

If you encounter further issues after the update, please don't hesitate to send us feedback on Twitter, Steam discussion, and our official Discord server. , thank you for your support.

notes.title: Development Update: FOV Slider, Steam Trading Cards, and More
notes.content:
The original Pascal's Wager was released on a vastly different platform, played on drastically smaller screensize with a different subset of control scheme. We were very clearly underprepared for the challenges and landscape of PC, and we would like to apologize for the suboptimal experience with the launch version of Pascal's Wager: Definitive Edition. With the amount of feedback gathered since release, we would like to talk about what we have in store for the game in terms of improvement and additions.

Camera and Controls

Pascal's Wager's control fundamentals are directly geared towards using a controller as the primary means to play, and we clearly underestimated the amount of PC players that primarily use keyboard and mouse to play similar games. This resulted in suboptimal controls for keyboard and mouse players. We have already released several updates to address this, and we are continuing to optimize game control for all players.


 Add an FOV slider.
 Separate controller and KB/M button prompts.

User Interface

The original Pascal's Wager's interface was designed for much smaller screen sizes than PC monitors and TV. The current interface experience is largely adequate, but the visual quality is not what we intend for the game to look like. For the next phase of development, we plan to do some adjustment to the user interface in order to make it more at home for PC monitor usage.

Visual Effects

We made several graphics enhancements for the Definitive Edition release. However, with much larger screens, the inadequacy of some of the original assets is quite clear (e.g., skybox in the first level). We plan to improve those shortcomings, and add more visual effect controls to game settings. In addition, we are adding new display mode for players to better utilize higher end hardware through DSR down sampling.


 Improve some lower quality assets.
 Add options for post process effects.
 Add exclusive fullscreen display mode.

We are also continuing to address game bugs and improve overall game stability. Outside of the game, we also plan to add Steam trading cards, so players can showcase Pascal's Wager: Definitive Edition on their personal profile.

The development team thanks all players for your feedback and support for Pascal's Wager: Definitive Edition, and we as always welcome you to get in touch through Twitter, Steam discussion, and our official Discord server. Thank you for playing!

notes.title: Game Update 1.1.12: Analog Stick Bugfix
notes.content:
Good day, Couriers! We just released another update, which fixed the right stick issue regarding quick item wheel and document scrolling.

Update 1.1.12

Bugfixes

 Fixed an issue where players are unable to use the right analog stick to select and use items on the quick item wheel.
 Fixed an issue where players are unable to use the right analog stick to scroll down texts.

We apologize for the inconvenience, if you encounter further issues, please don't hesitate to send us feedback on Twitter, Steam discussion, and our official Discord server, thank you for your support.

notes.title: Game Update 1.1.9: Camera Stuttering Fix
notes.content:
We just published another update, addressing the main issue about camera bobbing/stuttering during sideways movement, alongside a few other changes, so check out the full patch notes below:

Update 1.1.9

General

 Tuned camera bobbing during sideways movement to reduce stuttering issues.
 Increased texture quality for Terrence's Herald outfit.
 Increased texture quality for the final boss character.
 Increased foliage rendering distance.
 Increased default field of view.

Bugfixes

 Fixed an issue causing mouse cursor to show up during cutscenes.


We would also like to apologize for the issues players have been experiencing since Pascal's Wager: Definitive Edition's launch. In addition, there have also been a few unforeseen issues due to our rapid iteration in recent updates.

We are hard at work accessing all your feedback and criticism and working on addressing them. There will be a detailed update report coming up soon. 

Please keep s​ounding off on your experience on Twitter, Steam, and our official Discord server, thanks for your feedback, criticism and support.

notes.title: Game Update 1.1.6: Mouse Camera Improvement
notes.content:
Good day, Couriers! We just pushed a new update for Pascal's Wager: Definitive Edition, addressing the highly received feedback that mouse camera control does not feel as good as it should be, please let us know what you feel about this iteration! There are also additional combat and bugfixes, so check out the full patch notes below.

Update 1.1.6

General

 Improved camera control behavior when using a mouse.
 Adjusted default camera position to further improve the whole camera movement experience.
Combat

 Improved parry and counterattack logic during the final boss encounter.
Bugfixes

 Fixed an issue causing certain locations to become inaccessible by jumping down from higher positions.

Note: due to underlying changes, you might see your in-game graphics and control sensitivity settings being reverted to default after this update, it's recommended that players check their in-game settings after applying this update to avoid control and performance issues.

We are continuing our efforts to improve the game and fix some of your most reported issues, so keep the feedback coming! You can expect a development roadmap in the near future as well. In the mean time, join us on Discord to directly report issues to us and talk about the game with likeminded Couriers!

notes.title: Hotfix Update 1.1.1: Game Language Fix
notes.content:
Good day, Couriers!

We just pushed a hotfix update for Pascal's Wager: Definitive Edition which addressed an emergent issue where players may find the game launching in Chinese.

Update 1.1.1

Bugfixes

 Fixed an issue where the game may not correctly set display language corresponding to system language upon first start.


In the coming days, we are also planning to release updates addressing some of the most commonly reported issues, including:


 Mouse camera movement controls
 Camera position
 Mouse cursor during cutscenes
 General stability and bugfixes


We appreciate your feedback and will continue to improve your gameplay experience. If you encountered issues or have any feedback, please head to our Steam forums and join us on Discord, and thank you for choosing Pascal's Wager!
